records.subject: Pain / ペイン

twelve_dimension_audit.ordinary_life: Drain-related envy and a conditional conversational affinity493 are represented. No performed leisure, food, finances, home, family or enduring social routine.

twelve_dimension_audit.Japanese_voice: Genuine ｟ ｠ thoughts are introduced375; colloquial 俺/challenge contrasts with explanation467 and qualified affiliation493. Distinguish imitation from actor and printed voice from acoustic proof; no full grammar or grade.

twelve_dimension_audit.gaps: Ordinary regulation, long-term loyalty, unfamiliar choices and isolated causal triggers are underidentified. Threat avoidance, care and self-preservation are overlapping rivals. No resurrection or species-wide psychology.
